Check before buying. pcieSlots: physical size, electrical lanes, PCIe generation and source (cpu/chipset), in the order the maker lists them (CPU slots first); lanes are the most the slot runs with the main CPU family the page lists (e.g. Ryzen 9000/7000, not 8000 APUs). m2Slots counts M.2 (Key M) SSD slots on the board, not slots on a bundled PCIe add-in card. wifi: none | wifi5 | wifi6 | wifi6e | wifi7. maxMemoryGB is the figure on the maker's spec page and can rise with BIOS updates. specSource = page checked (2026-11-11); MSI parts cite a datasheet that lists M.2/SATA/Wi-Fi only. cpuPower (optional): the CPU power sockets on the board, e.g. ["8-pin","4-pin"]; left out where it was not checked, and the cable step then asks for one 8-pin.
